title: Battle of Tannenberg
summary: A World War I battle in East Prussia in which German forces under Hindenburg and Ludendorff surrounded and destroyed the Russian Second Army under Samsonov. Of 150,000 Russians, 92,000 were captured. Fought barely a month into the war, it became emblematic of the Russian Empire's war experience and later a German symbol of pride.

importance.justification: Decisive early Eastern Front German victory that destroyed an army and became a lasting national myth.

audience_note: Describes battlefield deaths, mass capture and a general's suicide.
